text: Deploy a docs site quickly and make edits via either the web editor or a Git-based workflow
quote: Get started with Mintlify by deploying your documentation site in minutes and making your first content change with the web editor or Git.

text: Embed an AI chat assistant on the docs site that answers questions, cites sources, and generates code examples
quote: Add an AI-powered chat assistant to your documentation site that answers user questions, cites sources, and generates code examples on demand.

text: A platform agent researches, plans, and writes documentation, opening PRs with proposed changes for review
quote: Learn how the Mintlify agent researches, plans, and writes documentation, then opens pull requests with proposed changes for your team to review.

text: Automate doc maintenance by running the agent on a schedule, on repo pushes, or on integration events
quote: Automate content maintenance with Mintlify automations by running the agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events.

text: Automatically generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt so AI tools can index the docs
quote: Automatically generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt files so AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude can index and understand your documentation.

text: Site exposes a hosted search MCP server that lets AI tools like Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT search and retrieve content
quote: Connect AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT to your hosted search MCP server so they can search and retrieve content from your site.

text: AI tools can be given write access via MCP to edit pages, update settings, and open PRs against docs content
quote: Give AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor write access to your Mintlify content and dashboard so they can edit pages, update settings, and open PRs.

text: Every page serves a clean Markdown version by appending .md to its URL
quote: Add `.md` to any page's URL to view a Markdown version.

text: A skill.md file is hosted at the project root describing product capabilities for AI agents
quote: Mintlify hosts a `skill.md` file at the root of your project that describes what AI agents can do with your product.

text: An official CLI lets you preview docs locally, test changes live, and catch build errors before deploy
quote: Install the Mintlify CLI to preview documentation locally, test changes in real time, and catch build errors before deploying to production.

text: The web editor includes a built-in AI agent that writes/edits content, leaves comments, searches the site, and configures settings
quote: Use the editor's built-in AI agent to write content, edit pages, leave comments and suggestions, search your site, upload files, and configure settings.

text: API reference pages are generated automatically from OpenAPI spec files, including endpoints and navigation
quote: Generate interactive API documentation from OpenAPI specification files with automatic endpoint pages, request builders, and navigation.

text: Host docs on your own custom domain, subdomain, or subpath with managed DNS/TLS
quote: Host your site at your own domain, subdomain, or subpath with DNS records, automatic TLS certificates, and Mintlify-managed or proxy traffic routing.

text: A central docs.json file configures branding, navigation, integrations, and API settings for the site
quote: The `docs.json` file is the central configuration file for your Mintlify documentation site. It controls your site's global settings, including visual branding, navigation structure, integrations, API settings, and more.

text: Each pull request gets a unique preview URL so reviewers can see doc changes live before merging
quote: Get unique preview URLs for each pull request so reviewers can see documentation changes in a live environment before merging to production.

text: Run Mintlify in your own cloud or on-prem environment, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform
quote: Run Mintlify inside your own cloud or on-premises environment, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform including Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, and OpenShift.

text: Analytics dashboard tracks traffic, assistant conversations, search queries, engagement, and feedback
quote: Explore the Mintlify analytics dashboard to measure documentation traffic, assistant conversations, search queries, engagement, and reader feedback.

text: In-product search can be tuned with ranking boosts, max results per query, and product/version filters
quote: Configure the in-product search bar on your Mintlify-hosted documentation site: ranking boosts, maximum results per query, and product and version search filters.

text: A REST API lets you trigger deployments, embed the assistant, export analytics, and manage docs programmatically
quote: Use the Mintlify REST API to trigger deployments, embed an AI assistant, export analytics data, and manage documentation programmatically.

text: A separate Index MCP server gives AI tools read-only access to technical documentation and web context
quote: The Mintlify Index MCP server gives AI tools read-only access to technical documentation and web context.

text: Editor supports previewing, sharing, approving, and merging pull requests without leaving the tool
quote: Preview changes before they go live, share them with your team, and approve and merge pull requests from the editor.
